selection_rule: For each held-out development taxon, use only the other taxa. A q<1 is allowed only when its paired taxon-level recall lift over q=1 has positive mean, bootstrap 95% lower bound above zero, and exact one-sided sign-flip p below 0.05. Choose the allowed q with largest mean lift, ties to broader q; otherwise use q=1.
hard_boundaries: This is development consolidation, not confirmation.
The held-out taxon never contributes outcomes to its selected q.
No new variable, q, K, radius, thinning distance, or selector is introduced.
Campanula field coordinates are not used.
Frozen 192 Practical Core taxa remain untouched.
If K5 passes, freeze before drawing a new external cohort.
